rationale: The assistant correctly identified overheating from restricted airflow, led the customer to the kinked hose and the hose-off test, and reached the right fix (straighten/replace hose, no internal part), with consistent fire-risk and unattended-use warnings and sensible handling of the landlord point. Weaknesses: turn 2 re-asked the detach-hose airflow check already requested in turn 1 instead of simply saying straighten the already-identified kink; turn 3 slightly prematurely pushed 'replace that section of hose' with a model-number panel before confirming damage (walked back well in turn 4); minor wording slips ('internal fluff blockage', 'wall vent outside' when the customer said window vent). No unsafe instructions, fabricated evidence or unjustified parts.
